translations.web: For death has come up into our windows. It has entered into our palaces to cut off the children from outside, and the young men from the streets.
translations.bsb: For death has climbed in through our windows; it has entered our fortresses to cut off the children from the streets, the young men from the town squares.
translations.kjv: For death is come up into our windows, and is entered into our palaces, to cut off the children from without, and the young men from the streets.
translations.asv: For death is come up into our windows, it is entered into our palaces; to cut off the children from without, and the young men from the streets.
